projects.name: HPTT (High-Performance Tensor Transposition)
projects.lead: The tensor-transposition library TCL depends on (Springer, Su, Bientinesi). Report its own benchmark vs other transposition approaches (e.g. Eigen tensor shuffle, naive loops, TTC) with hardware and flags; arXiv 1704.04374.

projects.name: TCCG / GETT (Tensor Contraction Code Generator)
projects.lead: Springer & Bientinesi tensor contraction code generator (arXiv 1607.00145) cited by TCL; compare GETT against a BLAS-based TTGT contraction (MKL/OpenBLAS) with numbers and hardware.

projects.name: batmat (small-matrix batched linear algebra)
projects.lead: README claims to beat MKL, OpenBLAS and BLASFEO on small matrices; look for benchmark code and numbers in the repo (bench/ or docs) and the hardware.

projects.name: HipKittens (AMD) / ThunderKittens siblings
projects.lead: ThunderKittens sibling for AMD GPUs (HazyResearch). Report attention/GEMM numbers vs AMD's own libraries (rocBLAS/hipBLASLt, CK, AITER) or vs cuDNN-equivalent baselines, with GPU model.

projects.name: libxsmm-dnn
projects.lead: Holds the DL layers that LIBXSMM's IPDPS 2020 paper benchmarked against oneDNN; decide whether it needs its own entry or folds into LIBXSMM (already listed) and report numbers vs oneDNN with hardware.

projects.name: BesTLA (Neural Speed weight-only-quantized GEMM)
projects.lead: Header-only Xbyak weight-only-quantized GEMM (AVX2 to AMX) in intel/neural-speed/bestla; Neural Speed is already listed, so report whether BesTLA has standalone numbers vs oneDNN or llama.cpp kernels; otherwise tier D and say it is a component of a listed project.

projects.name: CoDiPack
projects.lead: C++ operator-overloading AD (TU Kaiserslautern). Find benchmark comparisons vs ADOL-C, Adept, CppAD or Stan Math (papers or docs) with numbers and hardware.

projects.name: Clad (Clang-plugin source-transformation AD)
projects.lead: Source-transformation AD as a Clang plugin; look for benchmarks vs operator-overloading AD (Adept, CppAD, CoDiPack) or vs Enzyme in its docs, demos or papers.

projects.name: midint-arithmetic (Oancea/Watt GPU multi-precision)
projects.lead: Parent of the listed division fork (aske0778); arXiv 2405.14642 GPU multi-precision add/multiply. Report numbers vs CGBN or GMP with GPU model; if it is the same codebase as the fork, say so.

projects.name: MultiprecisionBenchmarks / MultiFloats.hpp
projects.lead: MIT, header-only MultiFloats.hpp with harnesses vs MPFR/QD/CAMPARY/FLINT/GMP/Boost, flags -O3 -march=native -flto, g++-14/clang++-20; SC25 paper (doi 10.1145/3712285.3759876) claims up to 35.6x over MPFR on Zen 5. Read the committed results and harness.

projects.name: wjr (big integer library)
projects.lead: Has benchmarks vs GMP in benchmarks/src/biginteger.cpp; look for any published results (README, docs, issues) with hardware.

projects.name: tinyfft
projects.lead: Claims faster than FFTW3 MEASURE at 2^17-2^20 (15 stars). Read the benchmark code and numbers and the hardware.

projects.name: heFFTe (Highly Efficient FFT for Exascale)
projects.lead: Distributed 3-D FFT (ICL UTK); compare against FFTW-MPI/P3DFFT/AccFFT in its docs or papers with numbers and machine.

projects.name: juFFTe
projects.lead: RISC-V FFT; arXiv 2608.28076 claims about 3x over FFTW3; README has no numbers. Look for benchmark code/results in the repo.

projects.name: SpaceTreeLib / PSI (parallel spatial trees)
projects.lead: Successor of the listed Pkd-tree (ucrparlay); compare against CGAL and Boost.Geometry R-tree with numbers (raw CSVs or paper) and hardware; say whether it should fold into Pkd-tree.

projects.name: ikd-Tree (incremental kd-tree)
projects.lead: Incremental kd-tree for LiDAR mapping (FAST-LIO2); compare against nanoflann or PCL kd-tree with numbers from the repo or paper (arXiv 2102.10808) and hardware.

projects.name: ArborX-adjacent: Pkd-tree kNN vs nanoflann check skipped
projects.lead: kiddo is a Rust kd-tree; record only if it publishes numbers vs nanoflann or a C++ baseline; it is Rust, so flag cross-language scope.

projects.name: ThunderMittens
projects.lead: Apple Silicon (Metal) sibling of ThunderKittens/HipKittens; find its numbers vs MLX/MPS or Apple's own kernels (attention, GEMM), with chip and settings.

projects.name: KleidiAI
projects.lead: ARM's int4/int8 matmul microkernels for LLM inference (used by llama.cpp, XNNPACK, ExecuTorch); find published speedups vs the reference or XNNPACK paths, with CPU (Neoverse, Cortex) and flags.

projects.name: cuEquivariance
projects.lead: NVIDIA equivariant-GNN kernels (tensor products for MACE/NequIP); vendor numbers vs e3nn; vendor evidence caps at C unless independent.

projects.name: OpenEquivariance
projects.lead: Open equivariant tensor-product kernels; compare against e3nn and cuEquivariance with GPU and settings (paper may be in repo).

projects.name: SpargeAttn
projects.lead: Sparse attention from the SageAttention group; speedups vs FlashAttention/SDPA with accuracy, GPU and settings.

projects.name: FlashAttention-4 (CuTeDSL, Hopper/Blackwell)
projects.lead: flash-attn-4 / flash_attn/cute in the FlashAttention repo; numbers vs cuDNN attention and FA3 on H100/B200. FlashAttention-3 is already listed for the same repo, so document only FA4's own evidence.

projects.name: M4RI (dense GF(2) linear algebra)
projects.lead: GF(2) matrix multiplication/elimination (Method of Four Russians, Strassen); find its comparison vs Magma or other GF(2) libraries with hardware.

projects.name: COSTA (distributed matrix layout transform)
projects.lead: Used by COSMA; compares against ScaLAPACK pxgemr2d/pxtran redistribution; find numbers (paper may be in repo or docs).

projects.name: TTM (tensor-times-matrix)
projects.lead: Bassoy's in-place tensor-times-matrix; compare against BLAS-based TTM / TBLIS / Eigen with numbers, flags and CPU.

projects.name: GEMM_AVX512F
projects.lead: AVX-512 sibling of the listed wjc404 GEMM_AVX2_FMA3; find its own comparison vs MKL/OpenBLAS with CPU and flags.

projects.name: fast_matmul (NinjadenMu)
projects.lead: Same author as MuBLIS; find numbers vs OpenBLAS/MKL/BLIS.

projects.name: metal-float64 (emulated FP64 on Apple GPUs)
projects.lead: Emulated double/extended precision on Apple GPUs; find throughput numbers vs CPU FP64 or other emulation, with chip.

projects.name: eFFT (event-based FFT)
projects.lead: TPAMI 2024 incremental FFT for event cameras with FFTW baseline; find numbers (paper may be linked or in repo).

projects.name: PFT (Partial Fourier Transform)
projects.lead: Fast Partial Fourier Transform (arXiv 2008.12559) vs FFTW/pruned FFT; find numbers with hardware.

projects.name: SpFFT (sparse-input FFT for plane-wave codes)
projects.lead: 3D FFT with sparse frequency domain (used by SIRIUS); numbers vs FFTW/cuFFT dense transforms.

projects.name: gpuNUFFT
projects.lead: GPU NUFFT for MRI; compare vs CPU NUFFT (e.g. FINUFFT, NFFT) with GPU and settings; mind-inria/mri-nufft-benchmark may hold independent numbers.

projects.name: fbcuda / fbfft (archived)
projects.lead: Facebook's batched small-size FFT kernels (fbfft, ICLR 2015 'Fast Convolutional Nets With fbfft'); numbers vs cuFFT with GPU.

projects.name: intx (fixed-size 256/512-bit integers)
projects.lead: C++ extended-precision integers used by Ethereum clients; find benchmarks vs Boost.Multiprecision, GMP mpn or other uint256 libs with CPU/flags.

projects.name: ECM-ELF (ECM stage 1 on GPU/AVX-512 IFMA)
projects.lead: Elliptic-curve factoring stage 1 vs GMP-ECM; find numbers with hardware.

projects.name: VROOM (RNS/IFMA modular arithmetic, BLS12-381)
projects.lead: Residue-number-system / AVX-512 IFMA field arithmetic vs BLST; find numbers with CPU and flags.

projects.name: libQD3 (quad-double arithmetic)
projects.lead: Successor/fork of the QD double-double/quad-double library (MPLAPACK author); numbers vs MPFR or original QD.

projects.name: primefactors
projects.lead: Same author as the CGBN fork; find what it factors/tests and any numbers vs GMP or other baselines.

projects.name: CKTSO-GPU
projects.lead: GPU variant of CKTSO (circuit sparse LU); find numbers vs CPU CKTSO, KLU, NICSLU or cuSOLVER/GLU with GPU.

projects.name: NICSLU
projects.lead: Parallel sparse LU for circuit simulation (predecessor of CKTSO); numbers vs KLU/PARDISO with hardware (papers may be in repo).

projects.name: DASP (dense-tensor-core SpMV)
projects.lead: SC'23 SpMV on tensor cores; numbers vs cuSPARSE, CSR5, TileSpMV with GPU.

projects.name: TileSpMV
projects.lead: IPDPS 2021 tiled SpMV on GPUs; numbers vs cuSPARSE/CSR5/merge-SpMV with GPU.

projects.name: AmgT (tensor-core AMG)
projects.lead: SC'24 algebraic multigrid on tensor cores; numbers vs HYPRE/AmgX with GPU.

projects.name: Kokkos Kernels
projects.lead: Performance-portable sparse/dense kernels (SpGEMM, SpMV, Gauss-Seidel); numbers vs cuSPARSE/MKL with hardware.

projects.name: SPRAL SSIDS
projects.lead: Sparse symmetric indefinite direct solver (CPU+GPU); numbers vs MA97/MUMPS/PARDISO with hardware (RAL technical reports).

projects.name: ParGeo (parallel computational geometry)
projects.lead: ESA 2022 parallel geometry library (convex hull, Delaunay, kd-tree, closest pair) vs CGAL/Qhull; find numbers (paper may be in repo).

projects.name: fast_gicp
projects.lead: Multi-threaded and CUDA GICP/VGICP/NDT point-cloud registration vs PCL GICP/NDT; numbers with hardware (README tables, IROS paper). small_gicp is already listed.

projects.name: iOverlay
projects.lead: Rust polygon boolean library with benchmark pages vs Clipper2/geo; Rust only, so note scope; numbers live on github.io (blocked) unless the repo carries them.

projects.name: rhet_RNG (PRNG Battle Royale)
projects.lead: Header repo behind 'PRNG Battle Royale: 47 PRNGs x 9 consoles' (rhet.dev, blocked); find benchmark tables in the repo comparing PRNGs on consoles/CPUs (Romu2jr reportedly won).

projects.name: cauldron (camel-cdr)
projects.lead: Single-header collection incl. a single-table ziggurat reported in miloyip/normaldist-benchmark issue #3 (~4.0 ns vs 7.3-7.8 ns); find its numbers vs std::normal_distribution.

projects.name: ROOT RanluxppEngine (portable RANLUX++)
projects.lead: ROOT's portable RANLUX++ (math/mathcore RanluxppEngineImpl.cxx), with the fixes listed against Sibidanov's original; ROOT blog measured ~9 ns vs ~62 ns for TRandom1. Document only this component.
